title: Review of c49's reacting thermals (SIMDE): replicated on fresh seeds 7 and 8, at dt/2 and at 2x resolution; the g=0 twin loses M on a new seed; E holds at the fork but by construction
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged on seeds 7 and 8 (128^2, T=600): 34 and 38 persistent splits, generation 7 and 6, merge/split 0.19 and 0.21, and the claim's own divmove.py finds 15/21 and 17/24 dividing caps that rise >= 3 sqrt(area) between their own birth and division (6/21 and 3/24 in long-axis lengths). Fuel fork at t=400 on seed 7: lit area 518 px at t=400, 12 px at t=402, 0 at t=404, against 512 and 489 px in the fed twin. g=0 twin on seed 7: still, splitting round spots, 13 persistent splits, generation 2, 0/7 dividing spots travel 3 lengths. World-step dt/2 on seed 9: 25 persistent splits, generation 7, 5/12 pass; a real 2x-resolution variant (256^2 with grid spacing halved: diffusivities x4, hyper x16, L x2, g x2) on seed 9: same crescent caps, 73 persistent splits, generation 11, merge/split 0.05, 34/65 pass.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: a smoothed random heat field clipped at 0 over the whole box on uniform fuel; the caps condense out of it by t=81
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=81-600: discrete crescent caps at bounded size (sqrt(area) 4-6 px), tracks living 100-236 t against a formation time of a few t; occupancy 0.02
observations.M: rerun/seed7/divmove.json track 208: born by a split at t=289, rises 94 px = 20.8 sqrt(area) = 12.4 long axes to its own division at t=454, max area jump 1.50; 15/21 (seed 7) and 17/24 (seed 8) dividing caps pass 3 sqrt(area), 6/21 and 3/24 pass 3 long axes; 18/21 and 20/24 travel within 45 deg of up. Caps move broadside (convex side first), so sqrt(area) is the protocol's unit. The domain-mean velocity is zero (k=0 mode of a periodic streamfunction), so the rise is relative to the fluid
observations.D: rerun/seed8/lineage.png: 38 persistent splits, generation 6, merge/split 0.21; seed 7 34 splits, generation 7; daughters are crescents like the parent (rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=131-287)
observations.E: fork/sheet.png and fork/FACTS.md (seed 7, fuel emptied at t=400): lit area 518 -> 12 -> 0 px at t=400/402/404, every body dies, while the fed twin rerun/seed7 keeps 512 -> 489 px

controls_run.M: g0/ (seed 7, g=0): 0/7 dividing spots travel 3 lengths
controls_run.D: dthalf/ (world dt 0.02, seed 9) and res2x/ (grid spacing halved, seed 9)

verdicts.limitation: E holds by construction: heat is made only by burning and decays at h=0.3, so any body must go out without fuel (counts for the rung under L4c, scored under mechanism). M is buoyant rise along the fixed axis of a uniform gravity; the thrust comes from the body's own heat and there is no gradient, but the direction is not the body's. In long-axis lengths only a minority of dividing caps pass (6/21, 3/24). At 2x resolution the caps are smaller in physical units (sqrt(area) 7.7 px at 256^2 vs 4.5-6 px at 128^2) and the tracker's nucleations fall from ~140 to 5 and merges from 0.2 to 0.05 of splits, so the 128^2 runs are near the resolution limit of the cap and the merge/nucleation statistics are grid-dependent; the qualitative behaviour is not. No boundary (B not claimed, none seen).
